tasks.short: Prepare scale drawings and architectural designs.

steps.what: Prepare scale drawings and architectural designs.
File the drawing on the project.

tasks.design: Preparing scale drawings and architectural designs stays at {OPS_SYSTEM}, in the architect's hands. {PROJECT} files the sheet that was prepared. A view is not generated in place of the drawing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sheets were saved under personal names, and an old drawing was issued by mistake.
tasks.enabler_now: A file name and a revision are fields. The drawing is not.
tasks.still_hard: A design that is not resolved, or a scale that does not read, stays the drawing.
tasks.human_edge: The architect sees a line that is to scale and still wrong.
tasks.altitude: Filing a revision takes less hunting. Preparing the drawings stays.

evidence.claim: Filing a named revision is a record. Preparing a scale drawing is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect prepares the drawings. Checking them against rules is a different task. The model does not draw a design that was not made.
Structured input: project id, sheet id, revision. Producer is the architect. A file with no sheet id is not stored as current.
Drawing time stays. The file does not change the sheet.
unknowns: Who may mark a revision current?
research_questions: How often is an old drawing issued because the file name was unclear?

already_counted.description: Preparing the drawings is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire revisions that are no longer current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If drawings are only on paper, filing does nothing and the preparation is unchanged. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design structures to meet safety and environmental rules.

steps.what: Plan or design structures such as residences and buildings.
List model misses against safety regulations.
Decide accordance with environmental and safety regulations.

tasks.design: Planning residences, buildings and other structures stays the architect's design on {OPS_SYSTEM}. A stored rule set can list misses. Accordance with environmental, safety and other regulations is the architect's decision. The list is not the design, and it is not a permit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Regulations were checked from memory near the end of the design.
tasks.enabler_now: A rule written as a limit can be listed. Whether the design accords with it cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A regulation that does not fit the building type, or a miss the architect accepts with a reason, stays a decision.
tasks.human_edge: The architect knows which rule this building is actually under.

ambition.what: A model change can show new misses the same week, and the design is not rewritten by the list.

tasks.altitude: Listing stored rules takes less hunting. Designing the structure and deciding accordance stay.

reach.task: See misses that were not accepted

evidence.claim: Comparing a model with a stored limit is a list. Designing a building is not.
Building rules differ by place. The source pack does not name one statute this decision would satisfy. The decision is the architect's note, not a permit.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect designs and decides accordance. Applying for a permit is a different task.
Structured input: rule id, limit, element id. Producer is the rule set and the model. A rule that is not stored is not listed, and the design is not changed to clear a miss.
Design time stays. A miss is not deleted.
unknowns: Is there a stored rule set for this building type?
research_questions: How often is a regulation found only at permit?

already_counted.description: Designing the structure is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire miss lists when the design revision changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If rules are not stored as limits, the list is empty and the architect still designs and decides. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Meet clients to review architectural drawings.

steps.what: Meet with clients to review or discuss drawings.
Write what the client asked to change.

tasks.design: The current drawings are assembled from {PROJECT}. Meeting the client to review or discuss them stays a meeting. The architect writes what was asked. The pack does not decide the change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Meetings used whichever drawing was printed, and the request lived in a notebook.
tasks.enabler_now: A current revision can be assembled. What the client meant cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A request that conflicts with the brief, or a drawing the client has not seen, stays the meeting.
tasks.human_edge: The architect hears which line the client is actually rejecting.
tasks.altitude: Assembling the current set takes less searching. The meeting and the notes stay.

evidence.claim: Assembling the current revision is a list. A client meeting is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect meets and notes the request. Changing the drawing is a different task.
Structured input: project id, sheet id, change note. Producer is the project for the sheets and the architect for the note. A note with no sheet id is kept as a remark, not a change order.
Meeting time stays. The pack does not rewrite a sheet.
unknowns: Who confirms a change before it is drawn?
research_questions: How often is a meeting held on an old drawing?

already_counted.description: The meeting is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire change notes once they are drawn or refused.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If revisions are not marked, the pack is whatever the architect selects and the meeting stays. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare contract documents for building contractors.

steps.what: Collect clauses and model quantities already stored.
Draft contract documents for building contractors.

loop.input: clause ids from the library and element ids from the model
loop.output: documents that cite only those ids
loop.check: a clause or quantity that does not trace is discarded
loop.stop: one draft; a missing clause is marked absent
loop.why_not_simpler: which clause applies, and any signature, stay with the architect

steps.what: Check the draft against the model and the works.
Issue the contract documents the architect accepted.

tasks.design: Clauses and quantities already in the library and the model are collected. A draft of the contract documents may cite only those. The architect checks it against the model and the works. {PROJECT} issues that accepted set to the building contractor. A missing clause is not invented, and the draft is not a signed contract.
tasks.previous_blocker: Contract documents were copied from the last job and edited by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored clause can be cited. Whether it applies to this building cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A works item the library does not cover, or a quantity the model does not have, stays a check.
tasks.human_edge: The architect knows which clause the contractor will be held to.
tasks.altitude: Collecting stored clauses takes less copying. Checking and accepting the documents stay.

evidence.claim: A draft that cites stored clauses is a pack. The source pack names rule checks on a building model and a signature by the architect. This is the pattern, not a measured case here.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect prepares and issues the documents. Signing the building contract is a different task if a client or a lawyer must sign.
Structured input: clause id, element id, quantity. Producer is the library and the model. An item that does not trace is discarded, not rewritten to fit.
The check is remaining time. The issue is the accepted set only.
research_questions: How often is a clause carried over from the previous job by mistake?

already_counted.description: Checking the draft is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire drafts when the model revision changes.

approvals.approved_version: documents the architect accepted for that issue

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If there is no clause library, the draft is empty and the architect still writes the documents. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Drawings, the design of the building and the client meeting stay the architect's. A rule list shows misses and does not redesign. Contract documents cite stored clauses only, and the architect checks them before they are issued.
reach: The client sees the filed revision, not an unnamed file.
The contractor prices the issued documents, not the draft.
skills_to_grow: Do not treat a rule miss as a design change.
Mark a missing clause absent rather than inventing one.
role.ambitious_version: A model change shows new rule misses the same week, and a contract draft does not leave with a clause that does not trace.
